SUBJECT: Brutus from The House of the Dead Overkill. One very large, thick muscular adult male mutant prisoner, bare tattooed upper torso, scarred pale grayish flesh, dense faded dark prison/tribal tattoos over chest, shoulders, upper arms and back. Head completely covered by the dark black-brown bag-like executioner hood visible in the game; keep its simple coarse cloth shape, do not add horns, ornate mask, helmet or glowing eyes. Muted dirty orange prison trousers, broad worn brown belt, heavy dark leather lower-leg cuffs and black work boots. Preserve stocky proportions, heavy chest, rounded thick shoulders, thick arms and legs rather than a slim armored soldier.
CRITICAL LATERALITY: his ANATOMICAL RIGHT FOREARM is replaced by the mechanical electrical bolt launcher seen in image 1, with heavy dark steel cylindrical barrel/coils and bulky mount attached at the right elbow. In a nearly frontal stance his RIGHT WEAPON ARM is on the VIEWER'S LEFT. No human right hand. His ANATOMICAL LEFT arm ends in a normal open human LEFT HAND on VIEWER'S RIGHT, with a thick brown leather wrist cuff. One weaponized arm and one hand only; do not mirror these. A compact industrial battery pack on the back and smaller belt-mounted hardware/cables follow the visible game equipment; only the portions naturally visible in a slight three-quarter view should show. No giant invented shoulder armor, no handheld rifle, no chainsaw, no shield.
POSE: broad planted frontal guard with torso turned very slightly to his left so the weaponized right arm remains readable on viewer left. Right cannon bent forward/down a little, left hand raised halfway with clawlike fingers. Both whole legs and boots visible, feet apart at a common floor height. Keep hood, body and equipment fully inside the frame. Show the equipment powered down: no lightning arcs, muzzle flash, blue aura or projectile. No extra prisoner, partner or corpse. Do not invent legible tattoo words where the source is too small.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the full transparent Dossier Curien Brutus sprite. Image 2 is supporting gameplay identity reference only. Correct ONLY the false concentric bullseye / target tattoo on the middle of Brutus's belly. That circular target is a mistaken copy of a game HUD marker and IS NOT part of the character. Remove every concentric ring and central target dot from the belly, replacing that small area with ordinary mottled pale scarred skin matching the surrounding abdomen. Retain a natural navel if visible, but absolutely no circle, roundel, crosshair or target tattoo. Do not add any replacement tattoo or lettering in this area. Preserve everything else as closely as possible: full-body composition and pose, hood, face covering, all other faded tribal tattoos, chest, shoulders, dark electrical launcher replacing ANATOMICAL RIGHT forearm on viewer LEFT, normal left hand on viewer RIGHT, back battery, belt hardware, muted orange prison trousers, cuffs, boots, crisp painted rendering and native transparent background. No extra characters, effects, scenery, shadow or text. Whole silhouette must remain entirely visible with transparent margins.
